subject: Is colspan with renderDataTable possible in shiny?

messages.author: 8a98edc55c6202fc
messages.subject: Is colspan with renderDataTable possible in shiny?
parts:
Is it possible to use colspan with renderDataTable (or by some other hack) to produce tables like this: https://datatables.net/examples/basic_init/complex_header.html

also posted on stackoverflow but so far no answer: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/24653641/is-colspan-with-renderdatatable-possible-in-shiny

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Is colspan with renderDataTable possible in shiny?
parts:
At the moment, no, it is not possible, but I do not think it is hard
to support custom table header and footer in the next version of
shiny. Please feel free to file a feature request to
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues so it will not be forgotten in
the future.

Regards,
Yihui
